lines.text: Find your vehicle-specific maintenance schedule and separate mileage, time, inspections and severe-use rules without relying on a generic chart.

eyebrow.text: Find the correct source before copying intervals

items.text: Identify the model year, engine or powertrain, country of sale and current odometer units.
Look on the manufacturer owner website for the manual and any separate maintenance or warranty booklet.
Check that the document covers your version rather than a similar car or another market.
Read the maintenance symbols, footnotes and special-operating-condition definitions before extracting rows.
For each job, copy the action, interval, conditions and page reference.

line.text: Enter the interval you actually believe, then turn on severe duty for that one job to halve it. Nothing here overrides your number with its own.
